run_rattle_test: run the main function to test that ASE rattle does not modify fixed atoms
test_rattle_constraints: test that rattling an ASE atoms object respects FixAtoms constraints on selected atoms
create_fcc100_slab: create an fcc100 copper slab with a 3x3x3 unit cell using ASE
add_adsorbate_to_slab: add a CO molecule adsorbate to an ASE slab at a specified height and offset
apply_fixatoms_constraint: apply a FixAtoms constraint to fix atoms by index mask on an ASE atoms object
